impacts.reason: The constructor pre-setting totalSupply while the vault holds zero assets is the stated precondition for the first depositor controlling shares; the recommendation explicitly states the vault should start with zero supply and mint only when assets exist.

The zero-asset pre-set supply is the stated precondition enabling later depositors to buy worthless shares; the explicit intent that supply start at zero and shares mint only when assets exist directly concerns preventing this.
The pre-set supply with zero assets is the stated precondition for distorted share accounting; the explicit zero-supply-until-assets intent directly concerns correct share/asset relation.

The assumption that share price reflects underlying assets is directly the topic of wrong NAV/share-price integrations; the explicit zero-supply-until-assets intent directly concerns correct share accounting.
The zero-asset pre-set supply is the stated precondition for draining subsequent deposits; the explicit intent that shares mint only when assets exist directly concerns preventing this loss.
